profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Donor Services Group
profile.summary:
Dynamic, intuitive, and result-driven IT Professional with exceptional technical acumen and extensive experience leading design, implementation, and testing of cutting-edge business software applications. Demonstrated expertise in data analysis and conversion, reporting, integration and troubleshooting. Seeks to leverage a vast array of technical skills and functional expertise to drive corporate growth in the role of a Senior Data/Software Engineer.

•	32 years solid experience in object-oriented programming, software development, and data analysis using multiple languages and frameworks.
•	Action-oriented leader with excellent analytical, problem-solving, and inter-personal skills to efficiently function in a team or independently to ensure proper execution of projects in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments with effective multi-tasking abilities.
•	Motivation to explore new technologies, to learn, and to overcome unique challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved and enhanced all DOS legacy programs written in FoxPro to Visual FoxPro, MS SQL, C#, and WPF.  Proactively trained Corporate and Management users on software applications, database management, data analysis, and interpretation to encourage self-sufficiency in daily data needs. Successfully executed system development projects via consistent positive track record meeting requirements on-time and generated complex technical assessments, developed solution alternatives, evaluated options, and provided recommendations considering efficiency and cost while adhering to compliance and quality controls. Conducted installation, configuration, and managed Microsoft SQL on-site, and within remote access including importing of large amount of text data into MS SQL to warehouse 200GB of Acquisition Data, and efficiently processed and generated a dialer call history of 800 million call dispositions from 2003 to present.

Designed, Programmed, and Maintained the following custom business applications:
Dialer Recon, Audit, and Closing System (from PostgreSQL to MS SQL) written in Visual Foxpro interface using MS SQL back-end.
Billing System written in Visual Foxpro interface using DBF and MS SQL back-end processes.
Real-Time-Stats Monitoring and Hourly Stats written in Visual Foxpro interface using MS SQL and PostgreSQL backend methods.
Caller Performance and Efficiency Stats written in C# and WPF.
CPS and Bonus written in C# and WPF.
Call History Data Analysis written in C# and WPF,
Backend Data System that process fulfillment and generate daily call disposition as per client data specifications with PCI compliance; auto-encrypt data, auto-upload to FTP, Statistic Reports, and auto send e-mail notification written in Visual Foxpro interface using DBF and SQL backend.

positions.title: IT Support / Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, coded, and maintained windows based proprietary Dental Management System from Visual Foxpro to Visual Basic 6.0 and MS Access 2000, then later upgraded to MS SQL 2000 database engine. Performed Y2K testing of all hardware and software systems of offices and upgraded the computers into higher / upgraded specifications. 

Provided phone and on-site technical support for 15 Dental Offices and the Corporate Office numbering more than 100 workstations (Windows 98 / 2000 / XP OS and MS Office 2000 application).

Installed and configured Windows NT / 2000, and ensured LAN connectivity between servers, workstations, printers, hubs, and routers of Dental Offices and the Corporate Office. 

Performed maintenance and developed strategic plans concerning the data communication infrastructure of the company.

positions.title: IT Support/Software Developer
positions.description:
Strategically constructed, formulated, and managed various application program using Visual FoxPro 3.0 / 6.0, Visual Basic 6.0, MS Access, SQL,  and Crystal Report 7.0 such as Project Scheduling - (Visual Basic / Access / SQL), Advance Shipping Notice - (Visual Basic / Access / SQL), Shipping Documentation - (Visual FoxPro 3.0 / 6.0), and Efficiency Monitoring System - (Visual FoxPro 3.0 / 6.0).

Created various reports and files utilized in the analysis of Job streams. Guided the end-users in analysis and provided daily support of Job streams.

Programmed and oversaw Text / DOS-based proprietary application program enabling Clipper 5.2e / FoxBASE such as Payroll System, Personnel Management System, Inventory - Purchasing Department, Checks Disbursement, A/C Payables, A/C Receivables, Bank Reconciliation, and Front Desk and Billing Systems for Finasisu Hotel and Oriental Hotel.

Assisted the Operations and Support Team’s IT Department in providing technical and system support 500+ workstations that utilized Windows 95/98/NT and AS/400 environments.

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.description:
Programmed and managed application program using Visual FoxPro 3.0 such as Real Estate Management System, Personal Stocks System (used personally by the owner of the company), and Project Scheduling.

Successfully computed and maintained Text / DOS-based proprietary dual language (English / Arabic) application program using Clipper 5.2 and Nafitha–Arabic emulators such as Payroll System, Inventory and Sales Invoicing, General Ledger, and Purchase Order.

Delivered technical and system support on more than 100 workstations using Windows 3.0 / 3.11 and Novell 2.21 / 3.11.
